title: A backup script with options

cases.name: copies into backup/ and prints nothing
cases.then: test "$(cat backup/a.txt.bak)" = A && test "$(cat backup/b.txt.bak)" = B && test -f a.txt
cases.then_fail: expected backup/a.txt.bak and backup/b.txt.bak with the same content as the originals

cases.name: -d chooses the directory
cases.then_fail: expected safe/a.txt.bak and no backup/ directory

cases.name: options can be combined
cases.then_fail: expected 'out dir/my file.txt.bak' (names with spaces must work)

cases.name: a missing file: exit code 1 and nothing is copied
cases.then_fail: a.txt was copied although another file was missing

hints: while getopts "vd:" option; do case "$option" in v) ... ;; d) outdir="$OPTARG" ;; *) usage; exit 2 ;; esac; done, then shift $((OPTIND - 1)).
Use two loops over "$@": the first only checks that every file exists, the second copies.
